verdict.rationale: Databricks documents querying its metric views directly from external BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Sigma, which is a first-party BI-tool integration claim. The pack never documents an official JDBC or ODBC driver; the only JDBC mention is an analogy describing Databricks Connect, not a driver. Missing for 10: documented JDBC/ODBC drivers, BI connection setup docs beyond metric views, independent or hands-on corroboration that dashboards connect without custom glue.

support.subject: As an analyst, standard drivers (JDBC/ODBC) and documented BI-tool integrations connect my dashboards without custom glue

citations.quote: Query metric views from Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, and other external BI tools.
